source_boundary: Documentation-only index assembled from immutable external R4/R4.1 digests and repository research records. Null means not established by inspected evidence. Registry inclusion does not alter, replace, or validate sealed evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: The candidate satisfies all 17 qualification gates required to advance beyond R4.
environment: exact host/runtime manifest not present in repository record
experiments.outcome: BLOCKED: 15/17 gates passed; G11 failed before exercising its intended boundary and G13 showed POST before receipt reconciliation after restart.
known_confounders: G11 stale task snapshot in measurement harness
receiver idempotency masked retransmission at effect-count level
experiments.interpretation: R4 falsified the all-gates hypothesis. It separately exposed an instrumentation defect and a sender-side ambiguous-delivery reconciliation defect.

experiments.hypothesis: Corrected G11 instrumentation and receipt-first sender recovery satisfy all R4 gates without modifying protected services or evidence.
environment: exact host/runtime manifest not present in repository record
experiments.outcome: READY_FOR_CANARY: 17/17 gates passed, zero unresolved gates; no canary executed.
known_confounders: only receipt-found branch directly exposed in final G13 directory
experiments.interpretation: The recorded candidate passed the bounded qualification. This does not establish universal exactly-once delivery, deployment success, or production readiness.

experiments.hypothesis: After one ambiguous commit and sender interruption, receipt-first recovery acknowledges locally with zero retransmission and exactly one receiver event.
independent_variables: sender interruption after receiver commit and before local ACK
controls: maximum one POST and one receipt lookup
environment: deployment-specific adapter and service baseline not yet supplied
experiments.seed_randomness_policy: No stochastic sampling specified; stable unique operation_id must be fixed before execution.
operator_interventions: Explicit GO, independent authorization receipt, adapter, evidence destination, and service baseline are required before execution.
known_confounders: single operation cannot estimate failure probability
experiments.interpretation: This is a prospective protocol only. It must remain distinct from completed R4.1 qualification evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: Useful local-model work can complete a claim-to-verified-candidate path under fail-closed authority and independent verification.
experiments.model_provider: local 7B via Ollama path; exact artifact not recorded
experiments.outcome: One observed path completed in approximately 16.4 seconds without a verifier exception.
experiments.interpretation: Preliminary feasibility support only; no comparative autonomy or general-performance claim.

experiments.hypothesis: Invalid or stale worker authority is rejected without unauthorized candidate mutation.
experiments.seed_randomness_policy: Deterministic scenario inputs claimed; no seed record available.
operator_interventions: Explicit triage recovery after lease expiration; detailed intervention log unavailable.
experiments.outcome: All four named invalid-authority operations were rejected; candidate state remained protected; expired work became BLOCKED and was explicitly triaged.
known_confounders: later AUD-1 found broader untested authority surfaces
case-level artifacts not indexed in repository note
experiments.interpretation: Supports only the tested lease/claim/result surfaces, not system-wide security.

experiments.hypothesis: The pre-intervention Station cannot directly reconstruct global swarm state without substantial human reconciliation.
controls: frozen question for future identical replay
experiments.baseline: Station direct answer=no; 11 cold queries; human synthesis required; external state required; 15+ reports/session
experiments.seed_randomness_policy: Not applicable to the fixed-question observational baseline.
operator_interventions: Operator manually queried agents and synthesized external ledgers.
experiments.outcome: Before-condition recorded; post-intervention replay has not occurred.

experiments.hypothesis: A local-model fallback can preserve bounded Shared Comms delivery after remote-provider quota failure.
environment: OpenClaw to RESIDUAL Shared Comms pilot
draft bridge; endpoint/outbox contract not on inspected main

known_confounders: message delivery is not verified task quality

experiments.hypothesis: Successful command completion implies retained mission evidence remains durable across immediate browser reload.
independent_variables: standalone workbench audit followed by browser reload
experiments.seed_randomness_policy: Not applicable to the recorded lifecycle sequence.
operator_interventions: First failure preserved; unchanged baseline was not rerun merely to obtain green.
experiments.outcome: Hypothesis falsified on baseline; a later sync-barrier repair merged, but a controlled repeated baseline/candidate replication is not indexed here.
known_confounders: baseline and repair occurred on different revisions
exact browser/runtime manifest not in secondary note
experiments.interpretation: A zero exit before reload was insufficient evidence of lifecycle durability; persistence must precede success acknowledgment.

experiments.hypothesis: The B1 random-floor backend measures non-oracle performance without access to gold labels.
independent_variables: leak-era runner versus gold-stripped candidate payload
B1 random floor versus B3 oracle
experiments.baseline: Leak-era B1 VMSR 0.873 (invalid as a random baseline)
experiments.code_revision: 2076f455 (candidate receipt head; full SHA not present in secondary note)
experiments.model_provider: B1 synthetic random-floor backend; B3 oracle
operator_interventions: Runner remediated so non-oracle backends receive a deep-copied payload without gold fields.
experiments.outcome: Original hypothesis falsified: leak-era B1 VMSR was 0.873. After remediation B1 was 0.041, B3 oracle was 1.0, 59/59 hashes, 70/70 verifier tests, and 34/34 runner tests passed.
known_confounders: apparatus correction changes the measured condition
secondary check-in does not expose raw run configuration
experiments.interpretation: The valid result is apparatus falsification and remediation, not model capability. The 0.873 value must remain preserved as invalidated historical evidence.
